key_terms.لِّلْبَشَرِ: For the people/humanity, referring to the general human race
key_terms.نَذِيرًا: A warner or herald who gives warning of impending consequences

ai.seo_question: What is the role of the Prophet as a warner for humanity?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this designation underscores the Prophet Muhammad’s role as a *nadhir* (warner) whose mission extends universally to *al-bashar* (humanity), reflecting the divine attribute of mercy. It highlights the eschatological urgency of the message, particularly in the context of Surah Al-Muddaththir, where the warning serves as a prelude to the Day of Judgment and individual accountability.
